BREAKTHROUGH INSIGHT:
Emotional blunting is not permanent hardware failure. It is a learned defensive pattern rooted in trauma. Mechanism: System 2 (analytical/explanatory) became so capable it intercepts emotional signals before System 1 (felt experience) can process them. The explanation fires before the feeling can land.

KEY EVIDENCE: Ned cried during the session — direct proof emotional access is not permanently offline.

ORIGIN OF PATTERN: Trauma-induced. System 2 developed as protection, became a productivity tool ('didn't need feelings to succeed'), then became the default operating mode.

IMPLICATION: Recovery pathway exists through pattern interruption + medication combination. Not 'fixing broken hardware' but 'unlearning suppression.'

NED'S OWN WORDS: 'I kept shutting it down. It is there for a reason. Maybe I started blunting because of trauma. But the same mechanism of blunting works for productive reasons. I didn't know a better fucking way.'
